1: // Canvas Runner Game
2: // Assumes an HTML canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
9:   // Ground thickness for visual floor
10:   const GROUND_HEIGHT = 20;
11:   const GROUND_TOP = HEIGHT - GROUND_HEIGHT;
12:   const GROUND_Y = GROUND_TOP - PLAYER_SIZE;
13: 
14:   // ----- Sound setup -----
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16: 
17:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
18:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
19:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
20:     osc.type = 'sine';
21:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
23:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
24:     osc.start();
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:   }
27: 
28:   function playJumpSound() { playTone(300, 0.1); }
29:   function playGameOverSound() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
30: 
31: 
32:   const player = {
33:     x: 50,
34:     y: GROUND_Y,
35:     vy: 0,
36:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
37:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
38:     jump() {
39:       if (this.onGround()) {
40:         this.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH;
41:         playJumpSound();
42:       }
43:     },
44:     onGround() {
45:       return this.y >= GROUND_Y;
46:     },
47:     update() {
48:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
49:       this.y += this.vy;
50:       if (this.y > GROUND_Y) {
51:         this.y = GROUND_Y;
52:         this.vy = 0;
53:       }
54:     },
55:     draw() {
56:       // Draw player as a circle with gradient shading
57:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
58:         this.x + this.width / 2,
59:         this.y + this.height / 2,
60:         this.width / 4,
61:         this.x + this.width / 2,
62:         this.y + this.height / 2,
63:         this.width / 2
64:       );
65:       gradient.addColorStop(0, '#a0ffa0');
66:       gradient.addColorStop(1, '#0f0');
67:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
68:       ctx.beginPath();
69:       ctx.arc(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height / 2, this.width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
70:       ctx.fill();
71:     }
72:   };
73: 
74:   const obstacles = [];
75:   let framesSinceLast = 0;
76:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 150; // frames between obstacles
77: 
78:   function spawnObstacle() {
79:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30; // variable height
80:     obstacles.push({
81:       x: WIDTH,
82:       y: GROUND_TOP - size, // align spike tip with ground
83:       width: size,
84:       height: size
85:     });
86:   }
87: 
88:   function updateObstacles() {
89:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
90:       const o = obstacles[i];
91:       o.x -= speed;
92:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
93:     }
94:     // spawn new obstacles
95:     framesSinceLast++;
96:     if (framesSinceLast > OBSTACLE_SPACING) {
97:       spawnObstacle();
98:       framesSinceLast = 0;
99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   function drawObstacles() {
103:     // Draw each obstacle as a dark triangle (spike)
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
105:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
106:       ctx.beginPath();
107:       ctx.moveTo(o.x, GROUND_TOP);
108:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width / 2, GROUND_TOP - o.height);
109:       ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.width, GROUND_TOP);
110:       ctx.closePath();
111:       ctx.fill();
112:     });
113:   }
114: 
115: function drawGround() {
116:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321'; // brown ground
117:     ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_TOP, WIDTH, GROUND_HEIGHT);
118: }
119: 
120: function drawBackground() {
121:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
122:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky blue
123:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#b3e5fc'); // lighter near horizon
124:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
125:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
126: }
127: 
128:   function checkCollision() {
129:     for (const o of obstacles) {
130:       if (
131:         player.x < o.x + o.width &&
132:         player.x + player.width > o.x &&
133:         player.y < o.y + o.height &&
134:         player.y + player.height > o.y
135:       ) {
136:         return true;
137:       }
138:     }
139:     return false;
140:   }
141: 
142:   let gameOver = false;
143:   function loop() {
144:     if (gameOver) return;
145:     // Clear and redraw background and ground first
146:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
147:     drawBackground();
148:     drawGround();
149:     player.update();
150:     player.draw();
151:     updateObstacles();
152:     drawObstacles();
153:     if (checkCollision()) {
154:       gameOver = true;
155:       playGameOverSound();
156:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
157:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
158:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2 - 80, HEIGHT / 2);
159:       return;
160:     }
161:     // gradually increase speed
162:     speed *= 1.0005;
163:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164:   }
165: 
166:   // Input handling (spacebar or click/tap)
167:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
168:     if (e.code === 'Space') player.jump();
169:   });
170:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => player.jump());
171: 
172:   // Start the game loop
173:   loop();
174: })();
